actions.name: __adhoc_http_action
actions.title: Custom action
actions.help: Build your own HipChat action with a HTTP request. The request will be authorized with your HipChat connection.

input.name: mnemonic
input.label: Action name
input.hint: Give this action you're building a descriptive name, e.g. create record, get record

input.name: verb
input.label: Method
input.hint: Select HTTP method of the request

actions.name: add_member_to_private_room
actions.title: Add member to private room
actions.description: Add member to private room in HipChat

input.name: user
input.label: User
input.hint: Use ID or email address or @mention name (if abc is 'mention name', use @abc) of the user

input.name: room
input.label: Room
input.hint: Give either room ID or room name

input.name: room_roles
input.label: Room roles
input.hint: The list of roles for the user within the room, Valid values are 'room_admin', 'room_member'. Defaults to 'room_member'.

input.name: name
input.label: Name
input.hint: Must be 1 to 50 character in length

input.name: privacy
input.label: Privacy
input.hint: Whether the room is available for access by other users or not. Valid values are 'public', 'private'. Defaults to 'public'.

input.name: delegate_admin_visibility
input.label: Delegate admin visibility
input.hint: Whether the room is visible to delegate admins. Leave empty to use the group default

input.name: topic
input.label: Topic
input.hint: Topic for the new room

input.name: owner_user_id
input.label: Owner user
input.hint: The ID or email address of the room's owner. Defaults to the current user

input.name: guest_access
input.label: Guest access
input.hint: Whether or not to enable guest access for this room. Defaults to false.

actions.name: invite_user_to_public_room
actions.title: Invite user to public room
actions.description: Invite user to public room in HipChat

input.name: user
input.label: User
input.hint: Use ID or email address or @mention name (if abc is 'mention name', use @abc) of the user

input.name: room
input.label: Room
input.hint: Give either room ID or room name

input.name: reason
input.label: Reason
input.hint: Reason for inviting user. Valid length range: 1 - 250.

input.name: message
input.label: Message
input.hint: Valid length range: 1 - 1000

input.name: room
input.label: Room
input.hint: Give either Room ID or Room name

input.name: parentMessageId
input.label: Message ID
input.hint: The ID of the message you are replying to

input.name: message
input.label: Message
input.hint: Valid length range: 1 - 1000

input.name: room
input.label: Room
input.hint: Give either Room ID or Room name

actions.name: send_private_message_to_people
actions.title: Send private message to people
actions.description: Send private message to people in HipChat

input.name: people
input.label: People
input.hint: Use ID or email address or @mention name (if abc is 'mention name', use @abc) of the people

input.name: message_format
input.label: Message format
input.hint: Valid values are html, text. Defaults to 'text'

input.name: message
input.label: Message
input.hint: 10,000 character limit. If HTML message, must be valid HTML and entities must be escaped (e.g.: '&' instead of '&'). May contain basic tags: a, b, i, strong, em, br, img, pre, code, lists, tables.…

input.name: notify
input.label: Notify
input.hint: Whether this message should trigger a user notification. Defaults to false
